finding.summary: GitHub REST workflow-run evidence must pin and retain the selected API version. GitHub released REST API version 2026-03-10; requests without X-GitHub-Api-Version still default to 2022-11-28, and supported versions may later emit Deprecation and Sunset headers before returning 410 Gone. The workflow-runs endpoint caps filtered searches, including head_sha, at 1000 results.
finding.design_implication: Exact-commit enumeration is not provenance-complete unless the retained execution envelope proves authentication, Actions read permission, exact endpoint, Accept header, requested and response-confirmed API version, response deprecation state, rate-limit headers, page count, total count, and records digest.
finding.uncertainty: The validator is locally tested but has not yet been exercised against authenticated private-repository response headers.
finding.falsification_route: Run the exact-commit endpoint with an authenticated Actions-read token, retain response headers and records, and reject the envelope if GitHub does not return x-github-api-version-selected, if the selected version differs, or if live headers contradict the documented contract.
